2607.10190.title: PhysMRV: Physical Memory Retrieval and Verification for Physics Plausibility Reasoning
2607.10190.paper_summary: Video-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on video understanding and visual question answering, yet they remain unreliable in reasoning about physical plausibility, where understanding object interactions, causal dynamics, and fundamental physical principles is essential. This limitation is particularly evident on challenging physical reasoning benchmarks, revealing a persistent gap in physical commonsense reasoning. To address this challenge, we propose PhysMRV, a training-free physical memory and verification framework for physical plausibility reasoning. Unlike retrieval-augmented VLMs that retrieve semantically similar videos as additional context, PhysMRV transforms training videos into a Hierarchical Memory Bank of structured physical knowledge comprising three complementary levels: scene descriptions capturing visual context, physical-event graphs modeling object interactions and causal structure, and physics-rule summaries distilling reusable physical principles and cues. During inference, PhysMRV retrieves physically relevant memories and leverages their structured physical evidence to guide a frozen VLM in verifying physical plausibility, requiring neither fine-tuning nor parameter updates. We evaluate PhysMRV on three challenging physical reasoning benchmarks, ImplausiBench, IntPhys2, and GRASP Level 2, across multiple state-of-the-art VLMs. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements over direct prompting across diverse VLMs and evaluation benchmarks, showing that structured physical memories provide an effective and scalable means of enhancing physical plausibility reasoning without additional training.
2607.10190.paper_summary_zh: 視頻語言模型（VLMs）在視頻理解和視覺問題回答方面取得了顯著的表現，但在推理物理合理性方面仍然不可靠，理解物體互動、因果動力學和基本物理原則是至關重要的。這一限制在挑戰性的物理推理基準上尤其明顯，顯示出物理常識推理的持續差距。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了PhysMRV，一個無需訓練的物理記憶和驗證框架，用於物理合理性推理。與檢索增強的VLMs不同，後者檢索語義上相似的視頻作為額外的上下文，PhysMRV將訓練視頻轉換為一個層次記憶庫，該庫包含三個互補層次的結構化物理知識：捕捉視覺上下文的場景描述、建模物體互動和因果結構的物理事件圖，以及提煉可重用物理原則和提示的物理規則摘要。在推理過程中，PhysMRV檢索物理相關的記憶，並利用其結構化的物理證據來指導凍結的VLM驗證物理合理性，無需微調或參數更新。我們在三個挑戰性的物理推理基準上評估PhysMRV，分別是ImplausiBench、IntPhys2和GRASP Level 2，涵蓋多個最先進的VLMs。實驗結果顯示，在多樣的VLM和評估基準上，與直接提示相比，PhysMRV始終能夠實現一致的改進，顯示出結構化的物理記憶提供了一種有效且可擴展的方式來增強物理合理性推理，無需額外的訓練。
